items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I started taking care of all of his business, I really took care of all the contracts, hiring the boys... Because all the time Charlie was a gambler at heart

ctx.x: But how outstanding was he as a trumpet player?

That's what I'm telling you. If he just played one number per dance the people were happy. He was -- they thought he was the greatest trumpet player in the world. They didn't think about -- in those days folks didn't think about Louie Armstrong, it was Charlie Creth.
